description: Reads about messages to all the users of an app, or to the members of one group, that land in each one's inbox as a message from the developer. "estimate" { message, data?, group?, role? } says beforehand what it will cost, paid per recipient from the app's daily quota: recipients, credits, what is left today (available), percentOfDay and how many that reaches (reachable). "status" { id } and "list" show how far each send got (sent, skipped: terminated / inboxFull / gone). Needs the inbox module (feature_disabled otherwise). Sends nothing; neblla_broadcast sends and resumes.
name: neblla_broadcast_read
title: Broadcast (read)
